name: Pigeon Guillemot
desc: Pigeon Guillemot (Cepphus columba): hunts or scavenges other animals. Recorded 39 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The pigeon guillemot () is a species of bird in the auk family, Alcidae. One of three species in the genus Cepphus, it is most closely related to the spectacled guillemot.
